It’s not worth it.

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD - FAKE
reviews.text:
Absolute fake user base. I tested this app by chatting with 5 different profiles, and almost every single one gave identical, canned responses and followed the exact same conversation flow.
To confirm my suspicions, I ran prompt-injection tests and formatting scripts on them. Instead of reacting like real human beings, every single profile used the exact same automated evasion tactics—deflecting custom requests with carbon-copy boilerplate messages ("sure, but let me answer that later 😉") before instantly pivoting back to a pre-written flirtatious prompt.
It is 100% full of AI bots and scripted profiles designed to waste your time and keep you on the app. Save your storage space and steer clear.

reviews.text:
My experience with Once was frustrating. I matched with three different people and, just out of curiosity, asked each of them the exact same questions. Surprisingly, all three gave nearly identical responses, and they all replied around the same time. It made the conversations feel very scripted rather than genuine.

When I suggested moving the conversation to another app so we could chat more easily, each person said they were fine paying to continue talking on Once and suggested that I should just pay for it too. That only added to my suspicion that something wasn’t right.

I’m not saying that’s everyone’s experience, but based on mine, the conversations didn’t feel authentic, and I left feeling like the app was more focused on getting users to pay than on helping people make real connections.

I felt a deep connection with the guy I am chatting, but it seems that he avoids anything that involves proving he is real.   I felt like I am liking him a lot and that we developed something deep, but it’s not fair that, he would not verify that he is indeed real, and every other guy that sends me messages, have a pattern on “trust”, “I feel safer chatting here”, “I need more time before we can meet”, “I cannot take a picture of me showing you what you are asking for yet, I need more time” (what I was asking is a picture of today’s date l and time of sending the picture, not. A widget but an actual letter, watch or something saying what I requested or a picture showing what I asked written by hand and a selfie next to it).  

The app really made me happy for a few hours and I spent $212 on my gems, but the moment I run out of gems I am not using this app anymore, as I believe this is fraud, the person chatting with me is only active when I send messages, and they only send 1 reply after mine, they never send me messages on their own with “Good morning”, “how are you?” Or anything that a normal human being would do if they really liked the other person.

If we are chatting with bots or AI you should advertise that, if I need to file a lawsuit to get a refund I will, cause I believe this is the biggest fraud of all dating apps…

reviews.title: Best dating app ever
reviews.text: Probably the best dating/chat app ever. After trying all other major dating sites I never got a single like or a message. Within seconds of creating my account there were many attractive and younger women sending me likes and wanting to chat with me. Never had that before. What was even better was that none of these accounts wanted to move the chat to WhatsApp, email or mobile like you get with scam accounts. These women were just happy to politely chat. I was running out of credits quickly but the accounts I was chatting with may have an abundance of credits so you didn’t have to wait long for a response.  Only downside is the chat credits can get a little expensive so it was a little disappointing that I couldn’t keep up with the rate of chat. To say I feel lucky though is an understatement. Particularly as my chat isn’t up to much. To keep these women engrossed in a conversation was wonderful.
